orientation.note_en: The narrow house stands at the top (north) with its front gable facing south onto the open place; the only door is in that south gable over one stone step; the smoking chimney stack is on the rear (north) gable. The clearing of trodden earth spreads south of it; the wood closes in on the west, south and east; Alice's peeping tree is opposite the door on the south tree line; the path into the wood leaves at the south-east. Hero-scale plan (ridge 7.2 m). Camera positions in views[] are described relative to these landmarks.

views.desc_en: eye-level wide shot from behind the tree opposite the door across the bare open place to the little sooted house and its arched door, smoke pouring from the chimney
low-angle medium shot from the doorstep ground across the trodden earth to the tree line opposite, the sky framed by the crowns
eye-level wide shot from the west edge of the wood, sun behind camera, across the clearing to the step and the door
low-angle close shot from ground level up at the tall horseshoe-arched door and its carved stone lilies, the step towering in front
eye-level wide shot across the open place into the western sun, the house at the right of frame and dust in the air
eye-level medium shot from the doorway out across the clearing to the chipped tree trunk with plate shards at its foot
eye-level detail shot from the tree line of the pale chip in the neighbouring trunk and the white plate shards in the dry grass at its foot
high oblique wide shot from above the step across the clearing to the beaten-earth path leaving into the wood
high oblique medium shot from the eastern treetops across the steep slate roof to the tall chimney stack pouring grey smoke
